name: RIFLE DUELS
desc:
WELCOME TO RIFLE DUELS! 

Think you've got what it takes? Put your aim, accuracy, and recoil control to the test in competitive rifle battles.

⚔️ CHOOSE YOUR BATTLE
Take on opponents in 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 duels. First team to 6 points claims victory!

🎯 MASTER YOUR AIM
Perfect your recoil control, sharpen your reflexes, and outplay the competition.

💰 Earn coins by winning duels and unlock unique rifle skins
🔄 Trade your skins with other players
🔥 Battle it out and build your win streak
🏅 Prove yourself and rise through the global leaderboards!

⭐ Leave a like and favorite to support future updates!

💻 SUPPORTED DEVICES
PC • Mobile • Tablet • Xbox • PlayStation

⚠️ FAIR PLAY POLICY
Cheating, exploiting, and farming wins through alternate accounts will result in permanent bans.

llm.loop: queue for 1v1-4v4 rifle duels -> first to 6 points -> earn coins -> unlock and trade rifle skins
llm.objectives: win duels and climb global leaderboards
llm.progression: coins, rifle skins, win streaks, XP
llm.instructions: test aim and recoil control in team duels; first to 6 wins
